objective: For p >= 5, r | p - 1 and graded class-3 Lie algebras over F_p with a coprime split action (groups by the Lazard correspondence), write the count of homomorphisms over a character layer by layer (crossed homomorphisms through the BCH law: a layer-2 lift solving a cup-bracket equation, a layer-3 obstruction from cross-layer brackets and cubic BCH terms), show it depends only on cohomology classes, and specialize to manifolds with H1 = Z/r. Prove that the free class-3 group on x (trivial character) and y (character alpha, alpha^2 != 1) with C_r acting has, on every such manifold and in every sector, a count equal to an explicit constant times the Heisenberg (alpha, alpha) count, hence is #P-hard on r-surgeries of knots by CLASSK-DICHOTOMY-20261026-001C, although its class-2 quotient has no hard pair. Check the count formula against independent lifting counts and the reduction on many knot surgeries.
status: Proved by BEYOND-CLASS2-20261027-001A-P001: for p >= 5, r | p - 1 and graded class-3 Lie algebras with a coprime split action (BCH groups of exponent p), homomorphisms over a character are layered crossed homomorphisms (d f2 = -(1/2) f1 u f1, d f3 = -R(f1, f2)) whose completion counts depend only on classes; on manifolds with H1 = Z/r the trivial-character parts drop out. For the free class-3 group on x (trivial) and y (alpha, alpha^2 != 1), every sector count equals |Z1(F_alpha^k)| times the Heisenberg (alpha, alpha) count, so counting maps from r-surgeries of knots is #P-hard (CLASSK-DICHOTOMY-20261026-001C), although the class-2 quotient has no hard pair and is polynomial: past class 2 the criterion lives in the associated graded (cross-layer hard pair (y, [x, y])). Checked: 161 sector comparisons on 37 knot-surgery rows.
title: A cross-layer hard pair makes counting #P-hard although the class-2 quotient is easy
